blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Manila North Cemetery saw around 660,000 visitors on All Souls’ Day as of Monday night, with some of them said they came this day to avoid the influx of millions of visitors on All Saints’ Day in one of the biggest cemeteries nationwide. “We visited just now to avoid the huge crowds yesterday,” said Michelle Viernes, 31, in an interview with Inquirer, saying she and her family would visit six of their departed loved ones in the cemetery.
